nodes.title: study-audit
command: import sys; from pathlib import Path; sys.path.insert(0,'Tools/ChaosCrew'); import c1; r=Path.cwd(); e=r/'Documentation/ChaosCrew/C1.1/Evidence'; assert c1.manifest(r)==c1.read(e/'source-manifest.json'); s=c1.read(e/'study-summary.json'); assert s['scenarios']==200; [(c1.audit(c1.read(e/(k+'.json'))), c1.sha((e/(k+'.json')).read_bytes())==v or (_ for _ in ()).throw(ValueError(k))) for k,v in s['replayFingerprints'].items()]; assert not c1.read(r/'Documentation/ChaosCrew/C1.1/Comparison.json')['afterViolations']; c1.validate_candidate(c1.read(r/'FailureLedger/candidates/CF-c1-ca78b88c9c0e.json'),r); print('PASS: exact source, 200 current traces, repaired invariant and candidate review hashes')
